title: H-Index II
description: Find the h-index of a researcher given a sorted array of citation counts.

steps.note: Check mid = 2. citations[2] is 3. n - mid is 5 - 2 = 3. 3 >= 3 is true.
Condition met, move right pointer to mid - 1.
Check mid = 0. citations[0] is 0. n - mid is 5 - 0 = 5. 0 >= 5 is false.
Condition not met, move left pointer to mid + 1.
Check mid = 1. citations[1] is 1. n - mid is 5 - 1 = 4. 1 >= 4 is false.
Condition not met, move left pointer to mid + 1.
Binary search ends. Return n - left = 5 - 2 = 3.
